name: Pure Radiance
description: A creature that touches the creature takes 9 (1d6 + 6) radiant damage. Flammable objects that touch the xag-yi ignite and burn with a radiant fire for 1 minute. If a creature hits the xag-yi with a metallic weapon, the weapon suffers the effects of a *heat metal* spell for 1 minute.
